content: This document provides a summary of information about the product and does not include all possible details. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your specific needs. This information is not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and to address your individual health requirements. Adding plans enables you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same therapeutic class. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans allows you to make informed comparisons. Please note that the information provided is for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary details are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
